notes.title: The Symbiant Re:Union on the way to be banned
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44236416/1a2de7793778b85a47925b6887c59850c93fb5f2.png[/img]

Dear Terrans, The Symbiant Re:Union released this week finally!

We are proud and excited to be sharing Danya's and Brahve's adventures with you after a year of hard work!

Unfortunately, we have some bad news also.

After The Symbiant's ban in Russian last year, The Symbiant Re:Union is on the way to be banned in Russia also. A Steam user has informed us that he reported the game page to Russian authorities, and it's only a matter of time until Steam disables the page. This will make the game not visible or purchasable in Russia. (It will still be available in Turkey, Ukraine or Kazakhstan)

If you happen to be a fan of the games and are located on the territory of Russia, we advise you to get your hands on the game asap. The page will be disabled, and we don't know if going to take a day, a week or a month. 

The Symbiant and The Symbiant Re:Union will still be available to purchase outside this platform for users based in Russia. Please see our discussion forums [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2355140/discussions/0/4042609512656564155/]for more info here >[/url]

- HeartCoreDev
